comparison.objective: Guide a loop along a buzz-wire path without contact; unlike tuning an industrial shock absorber through repeated physical cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely continuous trajectory following and clearance control, versus bimanual mechanical adjustment, recessed tool use, tightening, and dynamic-response observation. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies traversing the wire without triggering contact; no path, contact allowance, timing, or completion rubric is available. Candidate instead requires two bounded carriage stops and retention testing.
comparison.reason: Collision-free path following tests a different physical ability and success outcome from damper commissioning.
